requirements: R1: The backend test suite runs against the same PostgreSQL database engine that is used in production, replacing the H2 in-memory database.
R2: The test environment setup uses Testcontainers to orchestrate a PostgreSQL instance for the tests.

slices.title: Migrate Test Suite to PostgreSQL via Testcontainers
slices.jtbd: When implementing the test suite database migration for this epic, I want to replace H2 with PostgreSQL using Testcontainers, so that the test suite runs against the engine that ships.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a backend Maven build process
When `mvn test` is executed
Then the test suite uses Testcontainers to spin up a PostgreSQL instance and all tests execute against it, preventing H2-specific schema validation failures.
slices.tocConstraintRef: false-positive test outcomes masking production defects
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce false-positive test pass rate due to DB engine differences from X% to 0%
